name: Odoo
summary: Odoo Community 20 with Caddy and PostgreSQL. Optional domain with HTTPS.
getting_started: Open your server address and sign in with the email and password shown once. The login and the master password are also stored on the server in /root/.beltoft-app/credentials.json. The master password protects database management; Odoo's database manager is turned off for safety, so it is only needed if you turn it on again in /opt/odoo/config/odoo.conf. Add a domain for HTTPS before real use; without a domain the address is not encrypted. Outgoing mail on port 25 is blocked on all servers; use an SMTP service on port 587 or 465 in Odoo's outgoing mail server settings. Backups are your job: because the database manager is off, back up the database with docker compose exec postgres pg_dump from /opt/odoo, and copy the filestore volume (docker volume odoo_odoo-data). Updates are manual: in /opt/odoo/compose.yaml replace the odoo image digest with a newer 20.0 one, run docker compose pull, then docker compose run --rm odoo odoo -d odoo -u all --stop-after-init, then docker compose up -d. This is Odoo Community, licensed under the LGPL-3.0; Enterprise apps need an Odoo subscription. The smallest plan runs Odoo for one or two users; for more users or several apps, choose 2 cores and 4 GB of memory or more. The OdooWoo helper module is installed in both editions. The Danish accounting edition also sets up Danish as the language, Denmark and DKK for the company, the Danish chart of accounts and VAT (moms) from Odoo, bank statement import and reconciliation, financial reports and the SAF-T file, which you find under Accounting, Reporting.
